title: The Great Battle Gaiden 2: Matsuri da Wasshoi
aliases: Great Battle Gaiden 2, The - Matsuri da Wasshoi
description: A Super Famicom platformer/shoot 'em up from Banpresto. It is a spin-off of The Great Battle games from the Compati Hero Series and the sequel to the Game Boy game Tekkyu Fight! The Great Battle Gaiden.
